open_items.ruling: Different product tiers must not be compared; a band or movement spanning tiers is not a market signal.
open_items.consequence: The observed-price envelope currently spans tiers and must not be presented as a price history until a tier dimension is carried on every observation and derived from visible captured bytes rather than part-number conventions.
